papers.claim_tested: With long open-loop commitment, cutting a flow-matching VLA's Euler steps from 10 to 2 contracts the action cloud around an unchanged centroid, saves most of the inference time and avoids edge-GPU thermal throttling.
papers.bar: median R(2)/R(10) ≤ 0.70 with the centroid within 0.05 relative and 3°; N = 2 latency ≤ 0.85 × N = 10 on the Orin, N = 10 within 5 % of 238 ms.
papers.theirs: R(2)/R(10) 0.51, centroid shift 3.2 %; 14.3 → 2.6 ms per step (A100); "eliminating edge GPU thermal throttling"
papers.ours: R(2)/R(10) 0.78 (CI 0.73–0.81), centroid 0.018 and 2.35°; 196.1 vs 237.5 ms per chunk (0.83, vision 151 ms); no throttling at N = 10 on the Orin, at MAXN_SUPER or 25 W
